scope: Full SalesBuddy 1.1.0 business migration into the existing Web; source provenance and intentional adaptations, not a production acceptance certificate.

upstream_archive.declared_compatibility: V195; supplied-package statement, not revalidated here

web_baseline.bundle_hash_note: SHA-256 of the exact web/bundle.js bytes inside the fixed Web archive; matches the original package comparison audit.

intentional_web_differences.decision: Keep /api/v1 and browser same-origin request/session isolation. Add the 1.1.0 endpoints and fresh current-company policy retrieval; do not port the native hardcoded production origin.
Preserve user-confirmed department_sales ranking while integrating team metrics and drilldown appropriate to Web. Do not replace it with native peer/team ranking solely because the ZIP differs.

Fresh company policy, exact amount acknowledgment, immutable identity/resource context, lifecycle guards. Final visit archival requires the current one-time confirmation object (started, visible, not consumed); direct, stale, hidden or reused tickets cannot save. Ignore transient amount acknowledgment in intent fingerprint only for the designated opportunity-create and visit-archive POST intents; retain it on the actual final payload.

Web does not require access.mini_program. Real permissions/grants drive route and action access with default deny. Capability-only legacy demonstrations have a bounded compatibility path; role names never override supplied real permissions. Navigation and quick actions use app.pageAllowed/can.

Bridge ordinary and hash query/scene company parameters, retain aliases and reject duplicate ambiguity. Remember company/account labels only, remove legacy stored passwords, isolate V3 history by API/mode, and invalidate old identity/pending login on company switch. Explicit company entry cannot be bypassed by demo autologin or one-click login.

Compile upstream business bindings into browser-compatible AST and connect desktop React views/components. Preserve existing Web navigation, layout, CSS and department tokens. Native WXSS is not copied over existing Web CSS. Added native business controls receive Web components/bridge behavior.

Keep the versioned renderer and colors from the delivered Web baseline; migrate natural-year active-customer meaning, full-set readiness, bounded refresh and lifecycle behavior. No native-style redesign is implied.

Deliver company/platform/activation frontend as an independent companion archive. Sales Web exposes same-origin /admin?company= only for live authorized console access. No backend frontend is published inside sales GitHub Pages; real backend/SQL/Worker/login/MFA/business operations remain unverified.

Coordinate browser-native modal focus with React dialog and sheet focus boundaries. Preserve the underlying task cancellation or advice sheet while its confirmation modal is open; recover focus after the native modal closes.

build_snapshot.boundary: Snapshot may precede the final integration build. Recompute after further source edits; do not use this label/hash as deployment evidence.
